research_question: Does an explicit Representation-Event-Morphology interaction improve subject-independent beat morphology beyond a conventional global temporal decoder?
hypothesis: A deployable event-derived R-to-R phase coordinate and event-conditioned morphology decoder are complementary: the full interaction should outperform either factor alone, not merely add parameters.

dataset.name: MMECG public
dataset.target_scope_guard: This gate supports beat-morphology claims only, not continuous ECG claims.

architecture.interaction: two soft R anchors define a differentiable R-to-R phase grid; representation and event fields are sampled on the same grid before morphology decoding
architecture.inference_guard: The canonicalizer consumes predicted event fields only; no ECG, cycle_bounds, validation labels, or subject calibration are inputs.

arms.role: matched structured decoder; neither event pathway nor phase canonicalization
event pathway with conventional whole-window interpolation
phase canonicalization with morphology-driven latent event field but no event supervision/conditioning
full REM interaction: supervised event field plus canonicalization plus event-conditioned decoder

controlled_variables.training: 80 epochs maximum, patience 20, AdamW, lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 16
controlled_variables.seed: base 42; effective seed 42 + fold; paired across arms within fold
controlled_variables.loss: same full-output reconstruction and Shape-200 loss; lambda_shape200 0.8 and PCC weight 0.5
controlled_variables.capacity: F00/F10/F01/F11 instantiate byte-identical parameter sets; switches change computation but not trainable parameter count
controlled_variables.checkpoint: best_shape200.pt selected using validation Shape-200 PCC only
controlled_variables.evaluation: validation-only during this gate; fold-macro reporting; test split never opened

interaction_test: For each fold and metric, compute (F11-F10)-(F01-F00). Report all fold values and their fold-macro mean; do not infer synergy from F11 alone.
promotion_gate: F11 improves Shape-200 PCC over both F10 and F01 on at least 2 of 3 folds
fold-macro F11 PCC exceeds max(F10,F01) by at least 0.02
fold-macro interaction contrast is positive for PCC and does not hide a worse RMSE
F11 event F1@50ms is not worse than F10 by more than 0.02
no arm uses test data, oracle anchors, or per-subject calibration
next_if_pass: Freeze F11, generate corrected loso_v2 4-second WSST caches for all 11 folds, run 11-fold MMECG plus at least three seeds for headline comparisons, then mirror on CR_RVS.
next_if_fail: Do not expand this architecture. Retain the incumbent and redesign the morphology mechanism from the failed factor/interaction pattern.
status: approved; implemented; unit-tested; awaiting clean commit and pilot launch
